svg.desc: 23,704 GitHub contributions across 166 active days, 2025-11-09 to 2026-11-12. The miner excavates real dates in ascending contribution-count order. Counts set quartz, copper, gold and diamond tiers. Excavating a consecutive five-day streak reveals a treasure chest.
